name: Jenne (Italy)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jenne (a burning green mount on white) within branches, with the inscription Città di Jenne in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Jenne, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 3 May 1940.

features.role: Jenne arms — burning green mount on white, crowned, within branches
inscription Città di Jenne beneath the arms
